verdict.rationale: Crossplane is an open-source framework you install into your own Kubernetes cluster to build infrastructure control planes, not a hosted AI or data-collecting service. A control for opting data out of AI model training is therefore a category error for this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence shows Crossplane collects user data or trains models; its AI mentions only describe AI agents consuming its declarative APIs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
